A daily updating web application for tracking the occurrence of marine heatwaves around the globe.

The Marine Heatwave Tracker is an operational web application for monitoring where marine heatwaves are occurring around the world. It brings together near-real-time event detection, historical context, and multiple environmental layers in a single public-facing interface.

**Links:** [Link](https://www.marineheatwaves.org/tracker.html)
